title: Central Shared Parameter Registry — First Citizen Set

scope.source_note: Only rows with explicit GUIDs are represented as registry entries in this migration candidate. Rows whose source contains '(from CSV)' remain unresolved migration items.

governance_contract.identity: GUID is the authoritative stable identity for a governed shared parameter; name is descriptive and collision evidence, not a replacement identity.
governance_contract.citizenship: Lane is the canonical Citizen/Visitor/Transition governance state. New observed GUIDs default to Visitor and require governed promotion before Citizen use.
governance_contract.lifecycle: Entry status records proposed, active, deprecated, or superseded state. Deprecated or superseded entries remain traceable but are not valid for new governed use without an approved transition/deviation.
governance_contract.binding: Binding type and applicable categories are governed when known. Missing binding/category data remains unresolved rather than inferred.
governance_contract.ownership: Owner/steward roles may be recorded per entry; project execution does not create parameter authority.
governance_contract.carrier: Derived Revit shared-parameter TXT files are carriers generated from governed Citizen + active registry state and do not supersede registry authority.

provenance.migration_note: Registry contract strengthened during GAP-S8-01 reconciliation using the Shared Parameter Governance Scaffold, existing GUID-first workflow, and STAR-T-GATE Inbox #8 as uncurated evidence. The Inbox proposal was adapted rather than copied: SP-01..SP-05 hard-coding, duplicate citizenship/lane fields, fixed group-name/data-type enumerations, and a weekly cadence were not promoted.
